items.name: b11972
items.body:
<details open>

common, mtmd: bound control vector layer indices and M-RoPE position loops (#31336)

* common: bound control vector layer indices by the model layer count

A direction tensor layer index is parsed from the tensor name with no
upper bound, and the buffer size and write offset are computed in int.
A large index overflows both, so the accumulation writes before the
start of the buffer.

Pass the model layer count to the loader, reject indices above it like
the existing zero index check, and compute the sizes in size_t.

* mtmd: fill M-RoPE positions by whole merge tiles

The position loops of the Qwen-VL, GLM, PaddleOCR and Qwen2.5-VL
encoders hardcode a 2x2 merge inside a stride of n_merge, so a patch
grid that is not a multiple of the merge writes past the positions
buffer. Iterate over whole merge tiles with n_merge inner steps, which
bounds the writes by the patch count and gives the same positions on
aligned grids.

PaddleOCR also requires a merge aligned image at graph build, as the
Qwen-VL family already does.

</details>

items.body:
<details open>

hexagon: add conv2d support (#30995)

* hexagon: add conv2d op

* hex-conv2d: add double-buffered staging

* hex-conv2d: full 64-wide activation block transpose straight from staged buffer

* hex-conv2d: implicit gemm

* hex-conv2d: remove scalar path and kernel

* hex-conv2d: unify conv2d kernel params for all paths

* hex-conv2d: scale HMX result before f16 storage and then restore during unpacking to prevent overflow

* hex-conv2d: fix f16 overflow in HMX paths

* hex-conv2d: refactor to rebase to new op fusion machinery

* hex-conv2d: restructure DMA pipelines and trace scopes

* hex-conv2d: removed the HVX_WIDTH and HVX_TILED paths

* hex-conv2d: remove in-loop vector spills

* hex-conv2d: refactor kparams, vtcm-layout and dma-pipeline to match the other ops

* hex-conv2d: add basic support for CONV_2D_DW

Co-Authored-By: Pranav Dhinakar <pdhinaka@qti.qualcomm.com>

* hex-conv_2d_dw: use DMA in all paths

* hex-conv_2d_dw: support for chunking larger inputs

* hex-conv_2d_dw: remove scalar/hvx access for w tensor (replaced with sync dma copy)

* hex-conv-2d: fix warnings

* hex-conv2d-dw: vectorize all paths

* hex-conv-2d-dw: tree-based reductions and unrolling to optimize

* hex-conv-2d-dw: uninline compute loops from dma loops

* hex-conv-2d-dw: move all kernel selection into the host solver and simplify/specialize kernel dispatch

* hex-softmax: update obsolete gates to enable SOFT_MAX for mmproj

---------

Co-authored-by: Pranav Dhinakar <pdhinaka@qti.qualcomm.com>

</details>
